warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Melee combat master wielding heavy weaponry and armor to overwhelm foes.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Ferocious combatant entering blood frenzy, sacrificing defense for raw power.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Heavily armored guardian of chivalry, specialized in stalwart defense.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Holy warrior of light blending martial prowess with restorative healing aura.

cursed-paladin.name: Cursed Paladin
cursed-paladin.description: Fallen knight channeling dark vows and maledictions against enemies.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.description: Martial battle maiden wielding holy spears with sacred fury (Shalltear class).

dark-knight.name: Dark Knight
dark-knight.description: Knight of shadow feeding on enemy terror and dealing unholy ruin.

niflheim-knight.name: Niflheim Knight
niflheim-knight.description: Elite frost sentinel encased in glacial northern legends.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Steadfast shieldbearer devoted to intercepting incoming attacks on allies.

fencer.name: Fencer
fencer.description: Agile rapier duelist capitalizing on precise thrusts, parries, and evasions.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Decorated arena veteran with immaculate weapon mastery.

world-champion.name: World Champion
world-champion.description: Legendary tournament title class of Yggdrasil possessing peerless martial dominance.

slayer-of-evil.name: Slayer of Evil
slayer-of-evil.description: Zealous hunter of undead and fiends delivering multiplied holy smites.

holy-lord.name: Holy Lord
holy-lord.description: Pinnacle of paladins radiating celestial blessings and divine protection.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Nimble scout skilled in lockpicking, pickpocketing, and silent infiltration.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Lethal executioner specialized in backstabs, stealth ambushes, and poisons.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.description: Eastern covert operative employing shurikens, shadow techniques, and ninjutsu.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: Master of intelligence gathering, reconnaissance, and covert disguise.

detective.name: Detective
detective.description: Inquisitor adept at tracking clues, deducing weaknesses, and solving mysteries.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Long-range marksman showering battlefields with lethal barrages of arrows.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Unarmed martial artist forging their body into living tempered steel.

ki-master.name: Ki Master
ki-master.description: Master of internal spiritual Ki energy delivering devastating bursts (Sebas class).

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: Scholarly arcanist studying spellcraft and commanding destructive elements.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: Innate spellcaster shaping primal magic through sheer force of will.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Master of dark rites raising the dead and commanding spirits.

master-of-death.name: Master of Death
master-of-death.description: Apex death sovereign (Eclipse) wielding spells like The Goal of All Life is Death.

demonologist.name: Demonologist
demonologist.description: Summoner binding infernal fiends and demonic entities from the abyss.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description: Conjurer summoning magical beasts, elementals, and outer planar spirits.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: Venerable scholar of high arcana unlocking primordial secrets.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Devout priest granting divine healing, protection, and blessed wards.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.description: High church official channeling extensive radiant prayers and blessings.

churchman.name: Churchman
churchman.description: Pious cleric bolstering moral resolve and religious fortitude.

miko.name: Miko
miko.description: Shrine maiden performing purification rites and dispelling curses.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.description: Spiritual guide bridging nature spirits and communion with ancestors.

general.name: General
general.description: Tactical commander directing battlefield movements and inspiring armies (Enri class).

noble.name: Noble
noble.description: High-born aristocrat wielding diplomatic authority, prestige, and estate wealth.

pack-leader.name: Pack Leader
pack-leader.description: Alpha creature commanding wild packs and buffing feral kin.

blood-drinker.name: Blood Drinker
blood-drinker.description: Martial class drawing vitality and stamina by drinking the blood of foes.

minimum.name: Minimum
minimum.description: A specialized vocational class allowing the user to manipulate their body size and shape.

cavalry.name: Cavalry
cavalry.description: Mounted lancer utilizing momentum for destructive charge impacts.

beast-rider.name: Beast Rider
beast-rider.description: Mounted combatant riding exotic beasts and ferocious war monsters.

beast-tamer.name: Beast Tamer
beast-tamer.description: Trainer subduing untamed predators and directing them in battle.

craftsman.name: Craftsman
craftsman.description: Artisan skilled in manual labor and constructing basic utilities.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: Forge master smelting metals into resilient armor and weaponry.

runesmith.name: Runesmith
runesmith.description: Ancient dwarven craft infusing arms with permanent magical runes.

weaponsmith.name: Weaponsmith
weaponsmith.description: Foremost blade specialist balancing and honing lethal weapon edges.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Brewer of potions, curative elixirs, and volatile alchemical concoctions.

jeweler.name: Jeweler
jeweler.description: Lapidary enchanting precious gemstones into warding rings and amulets.

tailor.name: Tailor
tailor.description: Textile master sewing wizard robes, garments, and lightweight leather armors.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Astute trader and negotiator skilled in economic appraisal and commerce.

mage.name: Wizard
mage.description: Scholarly arcanist studying spellcraft and commanding destructive elements.

overlord.name: Master of Death
overlord.description: Apex death sovereign (Eclipse) wielding spells like The Goal of All Life is Death.
